shared_elements: arm/limb rendered in relief on a vertical surface
justification: Both surfaces carry low-relief carvings including animals in profile and limb forms, but that is the extent of the correspondence: A shows an isolated, highly schematic quadruped and abstract bent-arm/hand-like elements on a plain pillar face with no framing, while B shows a naturalistic narrative procession of human figures leading a camel and carrying vessels, set between decorative rosette borders. The manner of depiction differs fundamentally, schematic and sparse versus modelled, proportioned and densely populated with repeated figures.
